data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'badl', meaning 'to replace' or 'to change'. In Islamic contexts, Badeela is associated with spiritual transformation and renewal. The name Badeela carries the meaning “Change, transformation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Badeela usually hope their child will grow to embody change, transformation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
